issues.problem: ka-question contrast for ね claimed ね 'never follows a question word', which is false (誰だろうね, 何ですかね are natural).
issues.action: Restated: ね cannot close a question-word question in place of か (何ですね is wrong).

issues.problem: ka-indefinite explain said が/を are 'usually dropped' after 誰か/何か; 誰かが来ました is common and correct, so learners could think keeping が is an error.
issues.action: Changed to 'often dropped', noting that keeping them is also correct.

issues.problem: kara-from explain said the end of a span is 'always まで, never に', which is false for movement (東京から大阪に行く is natural).
issues.action: Limited the rule to time spans and added that a spatial destination after から can take に or まで; the matching mistake note now says 'time span'.
